achievements.name: The Pilgrimage
achievements.detail: Leave the Brotherhood of the Silent Sorrow and begin the Penitent One's pilgrimage.

achievements.name: Prie Dieu
achievements.detail: Rest at a Prie Dieu shrine so the pilgrimage is recorded.

achievements.name: Confession
achievements.detail: Pay a Confessor to remove the guilt that is limiting your Fervour.

achievements.name: Ten Piedad
achievements.detail: Defeat Ten Piedad in Mercy Dreams.

achievements.name: Mea Culpa Shrine
achievements.detail: Spend Tears of Atonement at a Mea Culpa shrine to unlock a sword skill.

achievements.name: Rosary Bead
achievements.detail: Equip a rosary bead in an open knot on the Penitent One's rosary.

achievements.name: First Prayer
achievements.detail: Learn a prayer and cast it in battle by spending Fervour.

achievements.name: More Flasks
achievements.detail: Raise the number of bile flasks the Penitent One can carry.

achievements.name: Child of Moonlight
achievements.detail: Break a cage and free a Child of Moonlight.

achievements.name: Charred Visage
achievements.detail: Defeat Our Lady of the Charred Visage.

achievements.name: Map of Cvstodia
achievements.detail: Reveal every room on the map of Cvstodia.

achievements.name: Last Ascent
achievements.detail: Defeat the pilgrimage's final boss and watch an ending.

achievements.name: Wounds of Eventide
achievements.detail: Reach the ending that stays closed until you carry the Cvstodia of Sin and the Holy Wound of Abnegation.
